question: How likely is this account to renew, and what is the right next move for the account owner?

state_schema.usage: active seats vs licensed, 90-day trend, key feature adoption
state_schema.engagement: last exec touch, QBR held, support tickets open/closed, NPS or CSAT
state_schema.commercial: price change at renewal, competitor in play, procurement signals

criteria: will churn — champion gone, usage collapsing, competitor selected or procurement told us
at risk — usage down, exec contact stale, open escalation or a price objection
uncertain — mixed signals: healthy usage but no sponsor, or engaged but under-adopted
likely renew — usage steady, sponsor engaged, no open blockers, price accepted
will renew and expand — growing usage, seats capped, expansion asked for

moves.0: escalate now: exec-to-exec call, save play with a concession budget
moves.1: run the renewal playbook with a 60-day save plan
moves.2: book a discovery call to find the sponsor and the value gap
moves.3: standard renewal motion, confirm timeline with procurement

on_hold: Show the full distribution; a 40/40 split between at-risk and likely-renew is a discovery call, not a save play.
